id: title:jonmcwest:facet log body attributes not just resource attributes

review.posthog_relevance: Adds support for filtering and aggregating log-body attributes alongside existing resource and column facets, extending the HogQL query planning and API request handling.
review.reason: The backend implementation establishes a mutual exclusion check requiring exactly one of three facet parameters, while the frontend and test layers add the corresponding input and documentation. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement. However, the chunk explicitly lacks the backend query execution implementation and complete warehouse changes, preventing a '3
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the presence of the API and request handling implementation, but the actual backend query execution and warehouse query construction are absent from this chunk, leaving the complete end-to-end behavior unverified.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the new query execution path, the definition of the FACET_FIELDS constant, or the backend query construction.
